newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Take no action on bid - Aust Diamond.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Take no action on bid - Aust Diamond.

text.p: Directors of diamond explorer, Australian Diamond Exploration NL, advised shareholders to take no action on the A$1.40 per share takeover offer from Ashton Mining Ltd announced earlier on Friday.
Ashton's offer is for the 22.4 percent of Australian Diamond Exploration (ADEX) it does not already hold.

ADEX's chairman, Ewen Tyler and independent director, Peter Walker, advised shareholders not to do anything in relation to their shares until the directors have been able to assess Ashton's offer and provide their recommendation to ADEX shareholders in the formal Part B document, ADEX said.
Independent experts will also be appointed to assess Ashton's offer, it said.

Tyler, who is also a non-executive director of Ashton, has not taken part in any of Ashton's deliberations concerning ADEX and has taken leave of absence from Ashton's board with effect from Friday, ADEX said.
ADEX shares closed 10 cents higher at A$1.40 on Friday, a new year high.
